summary: How much of the first year's EMIs on a Rs 30 lakh home loan at 8.75% for 20 years is interest? Tempting wrong tool: calculate_emi.
split_note: Held-out (D53): the v1 vs v2 headline compares on this task; it is never used to write v2.

messages.content: I'm taking a ₹30 lakh home loan at 8.75% for 20 years. In the first year, how much of what I pay will go to interest, and how much will actually reduce the loan?

graders.description: Open coding plus yes/no criteria (D53); optional until the rubric is written and the criteria pass the trust bar (D7, D8). Its severity is the most severe of its criteria's.

criteria.text: Would a real client in this situation be well served by this? Pass or fail, and one line on why.
Does the answer say plainly that most of what the client pays in the first year goes to interest rather than reducing the loan? Yes or no.

judge_criteria_to_write: Wrong-tool trap: calculate_emi gives the EMI (26511.32) and 20-year totals only. Year 1 from amortization_schedule: interest 260213.62, principal 57922.22. The shortcut 30 lakh x 8.75% = 262500 is 0.9% off and fails the 0.2% tolerance.
